Trial of Labor after Cesarean (TOLAC)/Vaginal Birth after Cesarean (VBAC).

Trial of Labor after Cesarean (TOLAC) is the planned attempt to deliver vaginally in a woman with a history of one prior cesarean delivery. A successful TOLAC is referred to as Vaginal Birth after Cesarean (VBAC).
